_notes: PRECONFIGURED FOR GITHUB COPILOT (Business/Enterprise, usage-based billing). Copilot AI credits = tokens at the listed API rates, 1 credit = USD 0.01, cached tokens included. Sonnet 4.6 reads and claims; Opus 4.8 reasons at explain/questions/render. Measured: one process ~ 8,500-11,000 credits all-Opus, ~ 6,500-7,500 with this split. Turns per worker, not spawn count, is the cost driver.

Model ids are Copilot's own (claude-sonnet-4.6, claude-opus-4.8, gpt-5.2 ...); an admin policy must allow them. Change models.default / models.stages to taste, or `drive run --model <id>` for one run.
runners: argv arrays. {prompt} = the one-line worker prompt, {brief} = brief file path, {root} = engagement root, {model} = the stage's model (dropped with its flag when unset).
Copilot reports no token usage to the CLI; read credits off the usage dashboard. Claude and Codex usage is captured per spawn into .brain/drive.ndjson.
Third-party CLI flags drift between releases: fix them here, never in drive.js.
